- [arioso.platforms.udio.config](_autosummary/arioso.platforms.udio.config.html.md): Udio platform configuration (via udio-wrapper).

- [arioso.platforms.yue.adapter](_autosummary/arioso.platforms.yue.adapter.html.md): YuE adapter supporting fal.ai REST API and local CLI backends.
- [arioso.platforms.yue.config](_autosummary/arioso.platforms.yue.config.html.md): YuE platform configuration.
- [arioso.registry](_autosummary/arioso.registry.html.md): Platform registry with auto-discovery and lazy loading.
- [arioso.services](_autosummary/arioso.services.html.md): Lazy mapping of platform names to `ServiceHandle` objects.
- [arioso.tools](_autosummary/arioso.tools.html.md): High-level tools for common arioso workflows (submit, poll, download).
- [arioso.translation](_autosummary/arioso.translation.html.md): Parameter translation layer.
